task_name: Upgrade Residential Building and Inspect City Journal Objectives

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When a residential building displays a ready hard hat and the City Journal clipboard icon appears over Town Hall.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Upgrading the home increases population to 208, and inspecting the City Journal ('My Sweet Town') reveals the exact production and zoning tasks needed to earn the first bonus chest.
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Apply the Nails to the ready residential building, then open the Town Hall clipboard.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the left residential building

steps.briefing: drag the Nails onto the residential building to upgrade it.

steps.who: green 'Show me' button on Eva's City Journal prompt

steps.briefing: open the first chapter of the City Journal.
view the three checklist tasks (Produce 10 Metal, Produce 2 Nails, Create 3 Residential Zones).
